limits: Same AP source/proofs/helpers for each pair; includes parsing/synthesis/conversion and import-source work.
Fresh sequential processes, three repetitions; warm filesystem, no cache flush.
GNU time peak RSS KiB of wrapped command is not summed process memory; startup/allocator/kernel effects included.

No native cross-system reruns, universal ranking, accepted-only cost claim or other extra workload.
grant_launch_rule: Do not run before a new explicit grant. At launch derive only maximum_seconds=min(600,floor(remaining absolute grant seconds)-2), pin derived hash/UTC/remaining, and stop all children before deadline.
